headline: Zambia Launches First Domestic Gold Refinery to Boost Mineral Revenue
summary: Zambia has launched its first domestic gold refinery in an effort to increase the value derived from its mineral resources.
why: Zambia is a major African mineral producer seeking to capture more economic value domestically through local processing and refining.

impacts.name: Zambia
impacts.why: Domestic refining allows the country to export higher-value processed gold rather than raw minerals, increasing export revenues.
